title: What's in a name? The case for standardized nomenclature for mutualistic Mucoromycotina ‘fine root endophytes’
content: Multiple names are used to describe the same group of root-associated fungi. Following the International Conference for Mycorrhizas 12, we propose unifying them as ‘ֹMFRE’ to improve clarity and consistency and distinguish them from similar groups.
siteTitle: Journal of Experimental Botany Current Issue
